evidence.statement: The current LIFE-CODE evidence can be rendered reversibly as a graph of codebook entries, predictions, masked primitives, contexts and typed relationships without changing the underlying scientific claims.
The intended LIFE-CODE environment should expose synchronized source/decompiler and Blueprint/component views over the same evidence graph.
Typed compatibility ports and a fail-closed compatibility ladder can support future virtual assembly while preventing sequence-pattern fit from being misrepresented as biological interchangeability.
